duration.text: The Automation at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 16666 USD/per year ￥ 120000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Test ScoresIf you apply with either SAT (JI code: 6563) or ACT (JI code: 6983) test scores. Scores with writing test scores are preferred.2024 First-year admitted class test scores of Middle 50th percentile ranges: SAT total score: 1350-1450SAT Math: 730-790ACT total score: 30-33ACT Math: 28-35If you apply with A-level scores, you need to apply with Math A or above. If you apply with International Baccalaureate (IB), you need to apply with Math HL 5 or above or SL 7 in Math or above. Predicted A-level or IB scores are NOT accepted. Students with valid college entrance exam scores, please contact the International Undergraduate Recruitment Office at ji-intadm@sjtu.edu.cn. （e.g., Malaysia UEC exam scores, Kazakhstan UNT scores. France National Exam scores, and etc.）If you don’t have any exam scores mentioned above, you have an option to take the SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam in spring 2025 with other international students.

requirements.text: 1. High school diploma and above.2. Non-Chinese citizens who hold a foreign passport and comply with the relevant regulations set by the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC " and etc.
